opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs) and exempt/excepted charities; must have at least one year’s worth of audited or examined accounts; no specific income threshold for regular grants.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activities. Applications are accepted all year round with no set deadline. Proposals are limited to 10 pages.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, CIOs, exempt/excepted charities with annual income over £1 million, or projects/capital costs of at least £1 million; must have audited or examined accounts and meet the same eligibility criteria as regular grants.
opportunities.summary: Major grants of £100,000 or more for capital or project costs (minimum total cost £1 million) or core costs (organisation annual income over £1 million). Expressions of interest can be submitted any time; no fixed deadline, reviewed on a rolling basis and considered at eight board meetings per year.
